SPIREBROTHERS-AND_YOU_KNOW_WHAT.title: And You Know What?
SPIREBROTHERS-AND_YOU_KNOW_WHAT.descript: At the start of your turn, if you played both a [gold]Logic[/gold] and a [gold]Handy[/gold] card last turn, draw 1 card.
SPIREBROTHERS-AND_YOU_KNOW_WHAT.flavor: He always has one more thing to tell you.
SPIREBROTHERS-TRUSTY_MULTIMETER.title: Trusty Multimeter
SPIREBROTHERS-TRUSTY_MULTIMETER.descript: The first time each turn a [gold]Wired[/gold] effect triggers, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-RUBBER_CHICKEN_WITH_A_PULL: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Snappy Comeback[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Nobody knows why it works. It just does.
SPIREBROTHERS-NEVER_PAID_A_MECHANIC.desc: At the end of each combat, heal [blue]5[/blue] HP.
SPIREBROTHERS-NEVER_PAID_A_MECHANIC.flav: Why pay someone when you can do it yourself?
SPIREBROTHERS-GRAPEFRUIT.title: Grapefruit
SPIREBROTHERS-GRAPEFRUIT.flavor: Read the label. He did not read the label.
SPIREBROTHERS-TRANSLATION.title: Translation
SPIREBROTHERS-MONKEY_PHRASEBOOK.title: Monkey Phrasebook
SPIREBROTHERS-MONKEY_PHRASEBOOK.translat: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Insulted[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SPIREBROTHERS-MONKEY_PHRASEBOOK.flavor: Every page is the same three words. The pronunciation is what matters.
SPIREBROTHERS-STONE_MONKEY_HEAD.title: Stone Monkey Head
SPIREBROTHERS-STONE_MONKEY_HEAD.translat: The first time each enemy is [gold]Insulted[/gold] in a combat, it also loses [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-STONE_MONKEY_HEAD.flavor: It doesn't say much, but it means every word.
SPIREBROTHERS-MONKEY_WRENCH.title: Monkey Wrench
SPIREBROTHERS-MONKEY_WRENCH.translation: [gold]Comeback[/gold] cards get [blue]2[/blue] extra for each [gold]Insulted[/gold] on the target.
SPIREBROTHERS-MONKEY_WRENCH.flavor: Daniel insists this is the correct tool for the job.
SPIREBROTHERS-OLD_WALLET.title: Old Wallet
SPIREBROTHERS-OLD_WALLET.description: At the start of each combat, ALL players gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] per [blue]40[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] you have (max [blue]8[/blue]).
SPIREBROTHERS-OLD_WALLET.flavor: He never saw a reason to replace it. Or to open it.
SPIREBROTHERS-WELL_WORN_GUITAR.title: Well-Worn Guitar
SPIREBROTHERS-WELL_WORN_GUITAR.descripti: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Verse[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-WELL_WORN_GUITAR.flavor: It went to Japan with him, and it came home with him too.
SPIREBROTHERS-FAMILY_MINIVAN.title: Family Minivan
SPIREBROTHERS-FAMILY_MINIVAN.description:
Start each combat with [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Kids[/gold].
After each combat you win, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-WELL_TECHNICALLY.title: Well, Technically...
SPIREBROTHERS-WELL_TECHNICALLY.descripti: At the start of your turn, if you played both a [gold]Logic[/gold] and a [gold]Handy[/gold] card last turn, draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
SPIREBROTHERS-WELL_TECHNICALLY.flavor: He was right. He'd like you to know he was right.
SPIREBROTHERS-OVERSTUFFED_WALLET.title: Overstuffed Wallet
SPIREBROTHERS-OVERSTUFFED_WALLET.descrip: At the start of each combat, ALL players gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] per [blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] you have (max [blue]12[/blue]).
SPIREBROTHERS-OVERSTUFFED_WALLET.flavor: Same wallet. It just won't close anymore.
SPIREBROTHERS-SIGNATURE_GUITAR.title: Signature Guitar
SPIREBROTHERS-SIGNATURE_GUITAR.descripti: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Verses[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-SIGNATURE_GUITAR.flavor: Same old guitar, freshly restrung, with his name on the case.
SPIREBROTHERS-FIFTEEN_PASSENGER_VAN.desc:
Start each combat with [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Kids[/gold].
After each combat you win, gain [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-FIFTEEN_PASSENGER_VAN.flav: Finally, everyone gets a window seat.
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOWN_CARTRIDGE.title: Blown Cartridge
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOWN_CARTRIDGE.descriptio: At the start of your 2nd turn each combat, draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOWN_CARTRIDGE.flavor: It never works the first time. It always works the second.
SPIREBROTHERS-PARTY_HEADSET.title: Party Headset
SPIREBROTHERS-PARTY_HEADSET.description: The first [gold]Share[/gold] card you play each turn: you and its target gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-SHARED_STEAM_LIBRARY.title: Shared Steam Library
SPIREBROTHERS-SHARED_STEAM_LIBRARY.descr: At the start of each combat, add a random card from another family member's pool to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs [blue]0[/blue] this turn.
SPIREBROTHERS-SHARED_STEAM_LIBRARY.flavo: Everybody owns everything. Nobody remembers who bought what.
SPIREBROTHERS-BROTHERS_IN_ARMS.title: Brothers in Arms
SPIREBROTHERS-BROTHERS_IN_ARMS.descripti: At the start of each combat, ALL players gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] for each Spire Brother in the party.
SPIREBROTHERS-BROTHERS_IN_ARMS.flavor: Four brothers, one party, zero agreement on the route.
SPIREBROTHERS-DADS_TACKLE_BOX.title: Dad's Tackle Box
SPIREBROTHERS-DADS_TACKLE_BOX.descriptio: Upon pickup and at the start of each Act, obtain a random potion.
SPIREBROTHERS-DADS_TACKLE_BOX.flavor: Lures, line, three kinds of sunscreen, and something for whatever you've got.
SPIREBROTHERS-POCKET_KNIFE.title: Pocket Knife
SPIREBROTHERS-POCKET_KNIFE.flavor: Camping essential. Also opens packages he never ordered.
SPIREBROTHERS-GRAPHING_CALCULATOR.title: Graphing Calculator
SPIREBROTHERS-GRAPHING_CALCULATOR.descri: The first time [gold]Exact[/gold] triggers each turn, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-GRAPHING_CALCULATOR.flavor: He doesn't need it. He just likes being right twice.
SPIREBROTHERS-SAVINGS_ACCOUNT.title: Savings Account
SPIREBROTHERS-SAVINGS_ACCOUNT.descriptio: At the end of each combat, gain [blue]5%[/blue] interest on your [gold]Gold[/gold] (max [blue]20[/blue]).
SPIREBROTHERS-SAVINGS_ACCOUNT.flavor: Not saving for anything. It's just never been spent.
SPIREBROTHERS-SOAPBOX.title: Soapbox
SPIREBROTHERS-SOAPBOX.description: Your first [gold]Rant[/gold] each turn counts as [blue]2[/blue] Rants.
SPIREBROTHERS-PAYDAY_MASK.title: Payday Mask
SPIREBROTHERS-PAYDAY_MASK.flavor: The heist went loud. The math still worked out.
SPIREBROTHERS-LUCKY_PICK.title: Lucky Pick
SPIREBROTHERS-LUCKY_PICK.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Verses[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-LUCKY_PICK.flavor: He's lost a hundred picks. Never this one.
SPIREBROTHERS-LUCKY_D20.title: Lucky d20
SPIREBROTHERS-LUCKY_D20.description: Your first [gold]Roll[/gold] each combat is a [gold]Natural 20[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-LUCKY_D20.flavor: Kept in its own little box. Nobody else is allowed to touch it.
SPIREBROTHERS-OMAMORI.title: Omamori
SPIREBROTHERS-OMAMORI.description: Whenever any player heals during combat, they also gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-OMAMORI.flavor: A little charm from a shrine in Japan. Don't open it.
SPIREBROTHERS-CAPO.title: Capo
SPIREBROTHERS-SPOILER_LOG.title: Spoiler Log
SPIREBROTHERS-SPOILER_LOG.description: Your first [gold]Check[/gold] each combat finds [blue]2[/blue] items.
SPIREBROTHERS-SPOILER_LOG.flavor: He knows exactly where everything is. He'll still Check every chest.
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLD_RECORD.title: Gold Record
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLD_RECORD.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Chorus[/gold] card, ALL players heal [blue]2[/blue] HP.
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLD_RECORD.flavor: Certified gold in at least one household.
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOSE_LEGO_BRICK.title: Loose Lego Brick
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOSE_LEGO_BRICK.flavor: Nobody knows which kid left it. Everybody knows who stepped on it.
SPIREBROTHERS-JUICE_BOXES.title: Juice Boxes
SPIREBROTHERS-JUICE_BOXES.flavor: Bring snacks and they will come.
SPIREBROTHERS-GARRISONED_RELIC.title: Garrisoned Relic
SPIREBROTHERS-GARRISONED_RELIC.descripti: At the end of each combat, gain [blue]12[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-GARRISONED_RELIC.flavor: A monk carried it home. Now it pays for the next Age.
SPIREBROTHERS-FULL_BOOST.title: Full Boost
SPIREBROTHERS-FULL_BOOST.description: On your first turn each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
SPIREBROTHERS-FULL_BOOST.flavor: Kickoff with 100 boost. Supersonic before anyone blinks.
SPIREBROTHERS-STARTUP_SCRIPT.title: Startup Script
SPIREBROTHERS-STARTUP_SCRIPT.description: Each combat, the first [blue]2[/blue] non-Power cards you play gain [gold]Script[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-STARTUP_SCRIPT.flavor: Runs on launch. He wrote it once and never thought about it again.
SPIREBROTHERS-PATCH_PANEL.title: Patch Panel
SPIREBROTHERS-PATCH_PANEL.description: The first [gold]Logic[/gold] or [gold]Handy[/gold] card you play each turn also counts as the other.
SPIREBROTHERS-PATCH_PANEL.flavor: Every room has ethernet. Every port is labeled.
SPIREBROTHERS-SUPER_DESTROYER.title: Super Destroyer
SPIREBROTHERS-SUPER_DESTROYER.descriptio: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Stratagem[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SEA_GLASS.SPIREBROTHERS-DANIEL.title: Circuit Glass
SEA_GLASS.SPIREBROTHERS-DAVID.title: Ledger Glass
SEA_GLASS.SPIREBROTHERS-JOSHUA.title: Stained Glass
SEA_GLASS.SPIREBROTHERS-TIM.title: Blueprint Glass
SPIREBROTHERS-FLAME_ALTAR.title: Flame Altar
SPIREBROTHERS-FLAME_ALTAR.description:
Start each combat in the [gold]Shroud[/gold] for [blue]2[/blue] turns.
After each combat you win, heal [blue]4[/blue] HP.
SPIREBROTHERS-FLAME_ALTAR.flavor: Push the fog back a little further every night.
SPIREBROTHERS-KINDLED_FLAME_ALTAR.title: Kindled Flame Altar
SPIREBROTHERS-KINDLED_FLAME_ALTAR.descri:
Start each combat in the [gold]Shroud[/gold] for [blue]3[/blue] turns.
After each combat you win, heal [blue]6[/blue] HP.
SPIREBROTHERS-ARBITES_BADGE.title: Arbites Badge
SPIREBROTHERS-ARBITES_BADGE.description: The first Power you play each combat costs [blue]0[/blue].
SPIREBROTHERS-ARBITES_BADGE.flavor: Also gets him into the server room.
SPIREBROTHERS-JUDGES_BADGE.title: Judge's Badge
SPIREBROTHERS-JUDGES_BADGE.description: The first [blue]2[/blue] Powers you play each combat cost [blue]0[/blue].
SPIREBROTHERS-JUDGES_BADGE.flavor: He is the law. Also still the IT guy.
SPIREBROTHERS-GANG_COLORS.title: Gang Colors
SPIREBROTHERS-GANG_COLORS.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Toxin[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOT_CHEST.title: Loot Chest
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOT_CHEST.description: Whenever one of your cards [gold]Grinds[/gold], gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-SURVIVORS_LANTERN.title: Survivor's Lantern
SPIREBROTHERS-SURVIVORS_LANTERN.flavor: A little light goes a long way in the fog.
SPIREBROTHERS-CHEW_TOY.title: Chew Toy
SPIREBROTHERS-CHEW_TOY.description: The [gold]Mastiff[/gold] starts each combat with [blue]2[/blue] more [gold]Bite[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-CHEW_TOY.flavor: Reinforced. Cyber-mastiffs go through the regular ones.
SPIREBROTHERS-STORAGE_DRIVE.title: Storage Drive
SPIREBROTHERS-STORAGE_DRIVE.flavor: Full of iron ingots and nobody remembers why.
SPIREBROTHERS-COMMANDER_UNIT.title: Commander Unit
SPIREBROTHERS-COMMANDER_UNIT.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Metal[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-ENGRAVED_ZIPPO.title: Engraved Zippo
SPIREBROTHERS-ENGRAVED_ZIPPO.description: The first time you apply [gold]Ember[/gold] each combat, apply double.
SPIREBROTHERS-ENGRAVED_ZIPPO.flavor: "PVT PYRO" on the side. AIT never forgot, and neither did she.
SPIREBROTHERS-ETERNAL_FLAME.title: Eternal Flame
SPIREBROTHERS-ETERNAL_FLAME.description: The first time you apply [gold]Ember[/gold] each turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] more.
SPIREBROTHERS-DOG_TAGS.title: Dog Tags
SPIREBROTHERS-DOG_TAGS.description: Once per combat, when your HP drops below [blue]33%[/blue], gain [blue]33[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] (at the start of your next turn if it happens on the enemies' turn).
SPIREBROTHERS-SMILEY_SHELF.title: Smiley Shelf
SPIREBROTHERS-SMILEY_SHELF.description: Whenever you enter a treasure or [gold]?[/gold] room, add a smiley. At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] per smiley.
SPIREBROTHERS-SMILEY_SHELF.flavor: Little yellow faces, all lined up. Every one of them is having a nice day.
SPIREBROTHERS-CAMP_VICTORY.title: Camp Victory
SPIREBROTHERS-CAMP_VICTORY.description: At the start of each Elite or Boss combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Aim[/gold].
SPIREBROTHERS-CAMP_VICTORY.flavor: Named for V Corps. She was there first.
SPIREBROTHERS-PASSPORT.title: Passport
SPIREBROTHERS-PASSPORT.description: Each new Act, gain a stamp. Draw [blue]1[/blue] more card on turn 1 for each stamp.
SPIREBROTHERS-PUGSLEYS_COLLAR.title: Pugsley's Collar
SPIREBROTHERS-PUGSLEYS_COLLAR.descriptio: When you Rest at a rest site, heal [blue]10[/blue] more HP.
SPIREBROTHERS-PUGSLEYS_COLLAR.flavor: A red collar and a little bone tag. He always found a lap to nap in.
SPIREBROTHERS-SANDIS_SUNBEAM.title: Sandi's Sunbeam
SPIREBROTHERS-SANDIS_SUNBEAM.description: At the start of your 2nd turn each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
SPIREBROTHERS-SANDIS_SUNBEAM.flavor: Orange on one side, silver on the other. She always knew where the sun would be.
SPIREBROTHERS-MR_GORDO.title: Mr. Gordo
SPIREBROTHERS-MR_GORDO.description: At the end of each combat, heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
SPIREBROTHERS-MR_GORDO.flavor: A stuffed pig. Every Slayer needs one.
SPIREBROTHERS-WANT_TAKE_HAVE.title: Want, Take, Have
SPIREBROTHERS-WANT_TAKE_HAVE.description: Your first Attack each combat deals double damage.
